newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares up at noon on Zhenhua Port debut.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares up at noon on Zhenhua Port debut.

text.p: Shanghai B shares inched up at midday on Tuesday, with trading focused on newly listed Shanghai Zhenhua Port Machinery Co Ltd, brokers said.

The B index rose a meagre 0.035 point or 0.05 percent to 74.419 on volume of 10.836 million shares worth $3.461 million, with 4.7 million shares traded in Zhenhua Port and 3.5 million warrants in Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development Co.
Zhenhua's firm debut encouraged investors though it did not trigger heavy demand for other issues, brokers said.
Zhenghua Port ended the morning at $0.458 against its issue price of $0.433 on volume of 4.7 million shares.

"Some institutions are seen suppporting the newcomer's price, which is making it perform well," one broker said. "But we do not know how long it can last and how far the share price can go amid the currently weak market sentiment."
Another broker said: "Zhenhua's gains did not fuel buying interest in other shares and most investors are still cautious."
Of the 46 B share issues, 35 were traded, with 15 of them down, 12 up and eight unchanged.
Shanghai Dazhong Taxi was the star performer on speculative buying, rising $0.030 or 3.46 percent to $0.896 on thin volume of 163,000 shares. It recently reported sharply higher first-half net.

Shanghai New Asia was the second most active issue after Zhenhua, falling $0.008 or 1.81 percent to $0.432 on volume of 316,400 shares. Brokers said expectations of poor interim results pressured the stock.
Shanghai A shares were modestly higher on cautious buying, but trading was sluggish on a lack of fresh market-moving news, brokers said.
The A share index gained 1.440 points or 0.11 percent to 1,257.712 on volume of 160.6 million shares worth 1.7 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index rose 29.966 points or 0.80 percent to 3,757.327 points.
Tonghua Dongbao Medicines Co put in the best A share performance on bargain-hunting, rising 0.94 yuan or 7.06 percent to 14.25 yuan on volume of 1.0 million shares.
